preliminary_findings.coverage_gap: The new four-route corruption fixture covers excessive flat/nested metadata, float statementCount, string bytes, aggregate content, malformed manifest/folder/path, and oversized validation status. It does not establish no-payload-read/no-write behavior for representative malformed required file fields or several known numeric/identity guard families, including wrong-type content/path/version/sha256/validationStatus; unsafe, negative, decimal or out-of-range bytes/statementCount; and commit/object_format/parser-profile/repository identity bounds. Existing regressions may cover some semantics, but the observed fixture does not cover these families across all four readers. This is a preliminary acceptance coverage observation, not a source bug claim.
